title: Smooth finite-rank real vector bundles
statement: Let $N$ be a smooth real manifold without boundary [def-sfb-smooth-real-manifold] and $q\geq0$ an integer. A smooth rank-$q$ real vector bundle $E\to N$ is a topological real vector bundle locally trivialized as $U\times\mathbf R^q$, with fibrewise linear trivializations whose coordinate changes have the form $(x,v)\mapsto(x,g(x)v)$ with $g$ smooth into $\mathrm{GL}_q(\mathbf R)$. Equivalently the local coordinate changes are smooth maps into the continuous linear endomorphisms of the model fibre, with their usual operator topology. Fibre operations are the real vector-space operations transported by the trivializations.

source.place: specializes in one line: ContMDiffVectorBundle ∞ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q)) E I; lines 300–315 give the topological vector bundle assumptions and smooth coordinate-change condition. Finite-dimensional linear operators have their usual matrix topology.
